info.title: agent-sandbox
info.description:
Disposable, self-hosted sandboxes where AI agents run code, with snapshot,
rollback, and fork.

Authenticate every `/v1` request with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or
`X-API-Key: <key>`.

get.description: Report whether the server can reach its backend. No authentication required.

delete.description: Destroy a sandbox and its workspace. Snapshots of it remain.

post.description: Reset the sandbox's time to live, counted from now.
Run a command to completion and return its output.
Run a command and stream its output as it happens.

200.description: Newline-delimited JSON. Each line is `{"type": "stdout"|"stderr", "data": str}` and the last line is `{"type": "exit", "exit_code": int, "timed_out": bool, "duration_ms": int}`.
